policy.decision: Apply only these three explicit human-reviewed representative-domain assignments. Preserve any existing non-null Production value as authoritative and fail closed on conflict; perform no Role-to-Domain automation or unrelated reclassification.

review_scope.rationale: Kim Jeong-ho is chiefly represented by the production and systematization of geographic knowledge through landmark cartography, so knowledge is stronger than exploration. Jeong Yak-yong is chiefly represented by Silhak scholarship, reform thought, and an extensive intellectual corpus despite his government service, so knowledge is primary. Jang Yeong-sil is chiefly represented by engineering, invention, clocks, and astronomical instrument making, so technology is primary.
